scope: NativeInferenceEngine::sequence_nll — teacher-forced next-token NLL, one packed forward, no KV writes; mirrors native_eval_suite.evaluate_checkpoint metric (ppl = exp(nll / scored_count))

semantics: {0.0, 0} for fewer than two input ids
packed forward_hidden over full sequence; logits computed for all but final position
invalid target ids skipped (no out-of-range access)
numerically stable log-sum-exp (subtract max, log(sum exp), minus target logit)

python_parity.reference: native_transformer/benchmark.py _perplexity (teacher-forced loss over tiny PyTorch model, vocab=64 hidden=32 2 layers)

baseline_suite.exe.relevant_case: sequence_nll_scored_and_finite (232ms) — NLL finite, scored>0, perplexity sane

eval_suite.exe.relevant_case: heldout_perplexity_beats_uniform (32.1s) — real bundle held-out ppl < uniform baseline via sequence_nll

dialogue_suite.exe.relevant_case: dialogue_perplexity_beats_uniform (26.6s) — same metric over dialogue spec

determinism: greedy/packed-forward path is deterministic; sequence_nll reuses forward_hidden with no KV writes
fail_closed: unloaded engine → ENGINE_NOT_LOADED; empty/short input → zero scored tokens (caller must guard div-by-zero)
